headline: Ether Long-To-Short Ratio Rose 0.31 To 2.74, A 30-Day High
narrative: Ether's long-to-short account ratio on OKX rose to 2.74, up 0.31 over 24 hours and 0.88 over seven days. The reading is the 99.9th percentile of the last 30 days, in a span that runs from 1.0 to 2.74. The ratio counts long accounts against short accounts at that venue, not dollars, so 2.74 means long accounts outweigh short accounts by 2.74 to 1, and the rise means long accounts gained on short accounts.
author: jordan
